communicationContent.description: This file stores structured communication exercises. It is intentionally separate from the website interface.

scenario.title: Meeting someone new at work
scenario.prompt: A new colleague introduces themselves. Respond naturally and keep the conversation going.

scenario.title: Asking a teacher for clarification
scenario.prompt: Ask your teacher for clarification about something you do not understand.

scenario.title: Helping a customer
scenario.prompt: A customer asks for help. Respond professionally and guide the conversation.
